name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Sunbright Saunas was founded in 1992, and through time became a vast company with good reputation on the market, supplying its products to over 60 countries and regions of the world. A variety of infrared sauna cabins is available from 1 to 5 persons, hemlock or Russian spruce, etc. Each infrared sauna unit is made with care and high grade materials like tempered glass, stainless steel, ceramic heaters.



A whole list of certificates can back up the quality that is available for a very competitive price, but Sunbright saunas also have a great after service, which proves the reliability of the company and the professionalism. Cutting edge technologies, top grade materials, great customer services and an affordable price – this is all Sunbright Saunas.



So if you need to enjoy detoxification, stress reduction, pain relief, sleep improvement, weight loss and many more benefits of an infrared sauna for a fair price – Sunbright Sauna is for you
